newsitem.title: USA: Unapix to buy Miramar Images.
newsitem.headline: Unapix to buy Miramar Images.

text.p: Unapix Entertainment Inc said on Tuesday it had reached an agreement in principle to acquire all capital stock of Miramar Images Inc, a producer of audio recordings, long form video albums and children's products.
The company said that in 1995, Miramar's domestic and international sales totaled $4.4 million.
The purchase price of the acquisition, to be paid by the issuance of Unapix shares, would be equal to 125 percent of Miramar's book value at the closing date.

Based on Miramar's stated unaudited book value as of Dec. 31, 1995, the purchase price would equal approximately $750,000. Under the terms of the agreement, Unapix would also guarantee certain Miramar debt which is guaranteed by Miramar stockholders. Miramar employees, including its current president, would also receive Unapix stock options.
